subject: Government & PSU Careers
question: Who conducts the Engineering Services Examination (ESE/IES) for Group-A central government engineering posts in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics & Telecom?
options: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)

explanation.why: UPSC conducts the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) to recruit Class-1 engineering officers across railways, public works, power, defence, and telecom departments.
explanation.shortcut: ESE/IES is conducted by UPSC across Civil, Mech, EE, and E&T streams.
explanation.commonTrap: ESE currently covers core four streams (CE, ME, EE, E&T)—CSE graduates often target GATE-based PSUs, ISRO, DRDO, or NIC instead.

subject: Government & PSU Careers
question: Which Indian R&D organizations recruit engineers as Scientists/Engineers to build satellites, launch vehicles, radar, and defense systems?

explanation.why: ISRO (space systems) and DRDO (defense R&D) recruit engineers in CSE, ECE, Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, and Chemical fields via ICRB/RAC exams or GATE-linked shortlists.
explanation.commonTrap: Both organizations look for strong fundamentals in core undergraduate engineering subjects, not just rote facts.

subject: Government & PSU Careers
question: True or False: Major Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) such as ONGC, NTPC, BHEL, PowerGrid, and IOCL commonly shortlist engineering graduates using valid GATE scores alongside interviews.
options: True — valid GATE scores are a primary shortlisting route for many Maharatna/Navratna PSUs
False — PSUs legally prohibit using GATE scores for technical recruitment

explanation.why: Many major Indian PSUs partner with GATE or conduct targeted technical exams/interviews to select graduate engineer trainees across core branches.
explanation.shortcut: High GATE rank + interview readiness = strong pathway into PSU engineering roles.
explanation.commonTrap: Always verify each PSU's official notification year by year, as exact GATE paper eligibility varies.
